commands: set -euo pipefail; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {c++} END{print c+0}')" = '1'; echo MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo BTSNOOP_MODE=$(adb shell settings get global bluetooth_btsnooplogmode 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r'); echo HCI_SECURE=$(adb shell settings get secure bluetooth_hci_log 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r'); echo HCI_GLOBAL=$(adb shell settings get global bluetooth_hci_log 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')

set -euo pipefail; echo '--- HCI FILE HINTS ---'; adb shell 'for p in /sdcard/btsnoop_hci.log /sdcard/Android/data/com.android.bluetooth/files/btsnoop_hci.log /data/misc/bluetooth/logs/btsnoop_hci.log /data/misc/bluedroid/btsnoop_hci.log /data/log/bt/btsnoop_hci.log; do if ls -l "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo READABLE_TEST=$(test -r "$p" && echo yes || echo no); fi; done; find /sdcard -maxdepth 5 -type f -iname "*btsnoop*" 2>/dev/null | head -n 30'
set -euo pipefail; echo '--- BLUETOOTH DUMPSYS HINTS ---'; adb shell dumpsys bluetooth_manager 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'snoop|btsnoop|hci log' | head -n 30 || true; echo HCI_LOCATE_DONE
